// [ID]int 					= The ID of the object.                                   				//
// [NAME (LANG)]string 		= The name of the hardware feature in the respective language.  		//
// [DESC (LANG)]string 		= The description of the hardware feature in the respective language. 	//
// [DATE](MONTH) (YEAR) 	= The date when the hardware feature is available.     					//
// [RES POINTS]int			= Required research points.												//
// [PRICE]int				= How much the hardware feature costs.                 					//
// [DEV COSTS]int			= The development costs of the hardware feature.       					//
// [QUALITY]int				= Reflects the quality of the feature.                          		//
//							  The quality influences the review score of the console.       		//
//							  The higher the value, the more influence the feature          		//
//							  has on the review score.                                      		//
// [NEEDINTERNET]			= Needs Internet.														//
//                                                                                    				//
